items.text: “One sentence each, whoever wants: how did the week of daily practice actually go? Honest answers.”
“‘I did two days and stopped’ is an honest answer.”
A parent starts the round — arranged beforehand; anyone may pass
Thin or empty week? No guilt — “The practice picks up where you are, not where you were supposed to be.”
“Tonight is a fresh start” — everything tonight works whether you did seven days or zero
Word → Hearing → Faith — “hearing is a skill, and skills take reps. Last week was rep one. Tonight is rep two.”
Tonight one of the room’s own leads the walk-through — “The team is here. But the practice is ours now.”
Tonight’s passage: Mark 2:1–12 — the paralytic whose friends dig through a roof to get him to Jesus
Already PROAPTed it this week? Good — “a passage speaks differently on a second hearing. That’s not a theory; you’re about to test it.”
Same six steps as last week — Bibles open to Mark 2

panel.label: ROMANS 10:17
lines: “So faith comes from hearing, and hearing through the word of Christ.”

items.text: Pray — “Tell the Holy Spirit you want to hear what He has for you tonight — not what you already know about this passage.”
Read — once aloud, slowly; then silence while the room reads to receive
Observe — two layers, in order: first the data, straight off the page, then the interpretation — what stands out or surprises you in it. “Write three things — data first.”
Apply — “Where in your life are you the one on the mat — stuck, carried, waiting? Or are you one of the four — and who are you carrying?”
Pray again — “Tell God what you heard. Tell Him what you’re willing to do — or what you’re struggling to be willing to do.”
Tell — in your family cluster tonight — “it’s the step that makes the hearing stick.”

slides.title: Bridge to the Clusters — Pair Structure

items.text: Same pair structure as last week — parent with teen, from your own family, by default
One Reader, one Listener — after thirteen minutes, switch; stay with Mark 2 or take a fresh passage
“Same pair as last week is not a rerun — a parent and a teen telling each other what they heard, a second week running, is the design working.”
Your Cluster Companion settles any odd numbers; a small room stays as one circle
“Father, You’ve already spoken tonight. Speak again in the pairs — something specific, something each of us can hear.”
First pass (13 min) — Reader leads PROAPT; Listener works alongside without interrupting
Reader’s Tell at the end goes to the Listener — one sentence
Switch — roles reverse; same passage or new
Second pass (13 min) — same structure, roles reversed
Same unstick prompts as Week 7 — “one specific word or phrase that caught you” / “one situation in your life right now — be specific”
Feels like a rerun? “Then you know what it said Thursday. What is it saying tonight? Second hearings are where the specific word comes.”

slides.title: Tell Step — Sharing in the Cluster

items.text: “The Tell step — second time in the cluster, so you know the shape.”
One specific thing you heard tonight — one sentence — “We listen to receive.”
A parent opens the round — arranged beforehand, never a cold call on a teen
Teens choose their own depth; pass-anytime holds
Receive without preaching — “We hear that.” “Thank you for naming that.”
“Take what you heard with you. It was given to be walked out.”
Daily PROAPT continues — one passage, five to fifteen minutes, every day (journal Week 7–8 pages)
“If last week thinned out, restart tomorrow. No guilt, no doubling up.”
“Take a moment on the way home to notice what just happened in this room. One of our own led the whole practice tonight. That is the design working.”
